biography.plain_text: Justin Dye is an American investor and former Albertsons executive who founded Dye Capital in Florida. His retail career brought substantial performance pay and equity awards before he established his own investment firm. Originally from Winslow, Indiana, he has also led the cannabis operator Schwazze and served as a DePauw University trustee.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Albertsons, Justin Dye directed the practical work of combining grocery chains after acquisitions. He led the integration of Safeway, consolidated distribution, procurement and manufacturing, and reorganised information technology. The integration delivered substantial savings, while his responsibilities included moving the business towards digital services.

Dye studied political science at DePauw and valued the requirement to defend an argument, write clearly and solve unfamiliar problems. He later returned as a trustee as the university developed its School of Business and Leadership. His earlier industrial experience included managing General Electric’s X-ray equipment business in Hamburg and working on business development for its aircraft-engine division.

Current primary industry uses the mandatory Retail origin fallback. Current private-equity activity does not by itself establish Finance dominance, and multiple operating sectors without comparative weights do not establish Diversified.

SEC compensation totals contain grant-date values, vesting amounts and cash components with different meanings. No sum is presented as a net-worth estimate. Broad Self-made does not claim an unsupported independent start.
